# Termite mound ventilation, encoded for transfer

Function: hold a steady inner temperature while the outside swings. Behavior: warm air rises through narrow shafts and pulls cooler air in at the base, so the chamber stays near one value all day. Structure: a thick earthen shell with a network of vertical channels and a buried base.

The point of keeping this encoding is the shape of the idea, not the insects: a heavy buffer plus a slow passive airflow can replace a powered cooler for part of the day.
